title: Federated Scaling
Improved trained model transfer
body: This commit transfers the trained model from the client location to the local location immediately after an individual client finishes training. Before this commit, the transfer only occurred after all clients had completed their training.

title: Federated scaling
body:
This pull request adds the advanced simulation features developed for the FederatedScaling project.


1. Single-HPC advanced deployment features.
2. Support for FSDP/HSDP deployments.
3. FederatedScaling: a peer-to-peer, collective-based, high-performance single-HPC FL implementation
4. General refactoring and bug fixes of the internal xFFL code.

title: Sc25
body:
This pull request adds the experimental code developed for the SC25 submission.

1. Expanded benchmarking code for the aggregation method's network performance.
2. Plotting code for visualizing the system's network performance.
3. Scripts for learning convergence experiments.
4. Minor overall improvements to the distributed setup.

title: Updated CI
body:
This commit adds new tests on the CI. 
- Added the `config` CLI check using different Python versions and MacOS.
- Added the validation of the project files.
- Added `flake8` and `codespell` libraries to check the style.
- Fixed a wrong generation of the `training` CWL step.

title: Added meta device model loading to reduce RAM usage
body: With this fix, large model loading becomes possible with little RAM usage.

title: xFFL major revision
Use CWL Python bindings from `cwl-utils`
body: This commit replaces dict-based CWL templates with Python-based CWL objects exposed by the `cwl-utils` library. The main advantages are static checking and easier migration to new CWL versions.

title: Add .gitignore
body:
## Description

`.DS_Store` files will be pushed and stored in the repo. There is also one in the `datasets` folder. This adds a .gitignore file to remove the `.DS_Store` files, and removes the one in the `datasets` folder.
